thread:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Customers reporting increased 5xxs and request timeouts hitting API edge in apac and eu regions. Initial spike detected at 03:42Z. Public status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1890012345

oncall-rhea: I'm the lead. starting triage: edge metrics, connection pools, and recent infra changes. @sre-max can you join?

sre-max: joining. p95 for edge-gateway jumped from 200ms -> 1.2s, and 502/504 rate ~10% on apac-eu peering. Connection pool exhaustion on edge-proxy-2 observed.

eng-edge-lee: noticed a config tweak to keepalive/reset timers rolled at 03:30Z to address unrelated pod churn. reverting that change now. Rolling config back to previous keepalive values.

infra-jordan: removing problematic hosts from LB rotation to stop cascading failures: edge-proxy-2, edge-proxy-5. Command: `lbctl drain edge-proxy-2 edge-proxy-5`

support-cam: posting a short status to customers: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors in APAC/EU when calling the hosted API. Mitigation in progress. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1890012345"

incidents-bot: MITIGATION: config rollback and drains in progress. Observed 5xx drop from 10% -> 2% in 5m. p95 latency down ~450ms.

oncall-rhea: applying temporary request queue limit and increasing pool size on edge-proxies to reduce head-of-line blocking. Also enabling additional connection logging for 30m.

sre-max: root cause likely regression in keepalive timers causing upstream connection resets under burst. collecting tcpdump and stack traces for affected proxies.

eng-edge-lee: will add safe-guard to config change pipeline to block keepalive values outside recommended range.

product-nina: proactively pinging top impacted customers and offering one day of credits; prepping FAQ for CS.

infra-jordan: monitoring healthy backend capacity and scheduling rolling replacements for drained nodes once traffic normalizes.

incidents-bot: STATE: partial mitigation (recovering). Public page updated. Next update in 15m or sooner if status changes. Thread limited to incident leads.

support-cam: tickets labeled INCIDENT-1890012345 and customers notified.

oncall-rhea: postmortem owners: @sre-max (RCA), @eng-edge-lee (config pipeline), @infra-jordan (ops). Will file incident doc when stable."
